scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "!@workspace/mockup-sandbox" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:prod
scripts.build:prod: pnpm --filter @workspace/sztuzk-jewelry-studio run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/tuzakai-jewelry-designer run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
